findings.title: Pause menu item impossible without rulerRule
findings.body: In AlertRuleMenu.tsx line 123 the pause item is gated on `canPause && rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule) && groupIdentifier.groupOrigin === 'grafana'`. In the list view rulerRule is undefined by design, so even when `canPause` is true via the new promRule ability path the condition is false. Consequence: Pause/Unpause can never be shown from the list view despite the OR-combined ability check.

findings.title: Delete menu item requires rulerRule
findings.body: In AlertRuleMenu.tsx line 165 the delete item is rendered only if `canDelete && rulerRule`. When the caller passes only promRule (new GrafanaRuleListItem path) canDelete can be true via useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities but rulerRule is undefined, so no Delete item is ever rendered. Consequence: delete disappears from the list view and the handleDelete path requiring RulerRuleDTO is unreachable.

findings.title: Silence drawer never opens for prom-only rules
findings.body: In RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx lines 104-106 the drawer is rendered only if `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` where `rule` is the optional RulerRuleDTO. List-view callers now pass only promRule, so `rule` is undefined, the condition is false, but AlertRuleMenu still shows Silence via grafana abilities and calls setShowSilenceDrawer(true). Consequence: clicking Silence notifications does nothing, no drawer appears.

findings.title: Federated rule immutability removed
findings.body: In useAbilities.ts useAllRulerRuleAbilities now hardcodes `isFederated = false` with a TODO, removing the prior `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` check. immutableRule therefore no longer covers federated groups. Consequence: federated Mimir/Enterprise rule groups that must be read-only become editable/deletable/pausable from the UI.

findings.title: Missing React key on Grafana list items
findings.body: In FilterView.tsx the map over rules renders `<GrafanaRuleListItem>` without a `key` prop, while the datasource and unknown branches pass `key={key}`. The `key` is computed into state but not forwarded. Consequence: React reconciliation warnings, incorrect reuse of list item state, and degraded infinite-scroll behavior.

findings.title: Malformed grafana rule key with extra brace
findings.body: In FilterView.tsx getGrafanaRuleKey returns `grafana-${namespace.uid}-${groupName}-${rule.uid}}` with a trailing extra `}`. Consequence: frontend-only keys are malformed, risking confusion or collisions when deduplicating or debugging list keys.
